Explanation: The core value unit is temporary access to a listed vehicle. With Getaround Connect, that access can be granted digitally without the owner meeting the renter.
Getaround operates the marketplace and Connect technology. Getaround Europe was acquired by GoMore in May 2026.
Getaround has to make privately supplied cars easy to find, book and access without creating a traditional rental fleet.
Higher booking frequency increases marketplace activity and owner earnings.
Getaround must limit fraud, damage, access failures and periods when listed cars are unavailable.
Getaround coordinates the booking, payment, digital check-in and, for Connect cars, smartphone access.
Transaction Flows: ← Consumer · Book / Pay — The renter chooses a vehicle, books the rental and pays through Getaround. | → Consumer · Unlock / Cover — Getaround provides the digital rental flow and, for Connect cars, app-based access together with the embedded trip-protection layer. | ← Provider · Car / Listing — The owner lists a vehicle and makes selected time slots available to the marketplace. | → Provider · Booking / Payout — Getaround sends bookings to the owner and pays rental earnings after applicable service charges. | ← Partner · Coverage — Insurance partners provide trip coverage and risk capacity for eligible rentals. | → Partner · Premium / Claims — The marketplace channels insurance economics and claims activity into the insurance layer.
